Reason: Figure 2 demonstrates a visible visceral pleural line in the right hemithorax with an absence of lung markings peripheral to it, which is diagnostic of a pneumothorax. This finding explains the sudden clinical worsening and pleuritic pain, distinguishing it from pneumonia progression or ARDS which would present with increased opacities.
